title: User Registration with Pending Approval — Step 1

requirements.text: Add a user registration status system to the backend. Each registered principal must have a status field with possible values: SuperAdmin, Active, Pending, Rejected, Suspended. When the very first user logs in and registers, automatically assign them SuperAdmin status. All subsequent users who log in for the first time must be assigned Pending status.

quotes: First user automatically becomes Super Admin
All other users get a 'Pending Approval' status

acceptanceCriteria: The first principal to register receives SuperAdmin status stored in stable state.
All subsequent new principals receive Pending status on first login.
Backend exposes a query to retrieve the caller's own status.
Backend exposes a query for SuperAdmin to list all users with their statuses.
Backend exposes update calls for SuperAdmin to approve or reject a pending user.

requirements.text: After a user logs in via Internet Identity, check their registration status. If their status is Pending, display a full-screen waiting screen informing them that their account is awaiting admin approval. If their status is Rejected, display a full-screen rejection notice. If their status is Active or SuperAdmin, allow normal app access. If they are new (not yet registered), register them and then route based on the assigned status.

quotes: All other users get a 'Pending Approval' status and see a waiting screen after login

acceptanceCriteria: Pending users see a waiting screen with a clear message that approval is required, and cannot access any other page.
Rejected users see a rejection screen and cannot access any other page.
SuperAdmin and Active users proceed to the normal app flow.
The waiting and rejection screens are styled consistently with the existing app theme.

requirements.text: Add a basic Admin Panel page accessible only to the SuperAdmin. This page must display a table of all registered users showing their principal ID, display name (if set), and current status. The SuperAdmin must be able to approve or reject each Pending user directly from this table using action buttons.

quotes: Admin panel — basic user table where the Super Admin can approve or reject pending users

acceptanceCriteria: The Admin Panel page is only reachable by a user with SuperAdmin status; all others are redirected.
The user table lists all registered principals with their status displayed as a badge.
Approve and Reject buttons appear for each user with Pending status.
Clicking Approve updates the user's status to Active; clicking Reject updates it to Rejected.
The table refreshes after each approve or reject action.
A non-SuperAdmin who navigates to the Admin Panel URL sees an Access Denied message.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo as a single actor.
Do not break any existing file storage, folder, sharing, or trash functionality.
Use only Internet Identity for authentication — no third-party auth providers.
nonGoals: RBAC permission matrix and custom roles (deferred to a later step).
Detailed audit logs with before/after values (deferred to a later step).
Configurable per-user storage quotas via the admin dashboard (deferred to a later step).
User suspension and deactivation flows (deferred to a later step).
Advanced user table filters (Pending/Active/Suspended/Rejected dropdowns) — only basic status display is in scope.
